items.markdown:
Tom yum is `a famous hot and sour soup from Thailand` . The name comes from two Thai words: *tom* , which means boiling, and *yum* , which means mixed. It features a bright, aromatic broth packed with bold spices, herbs, and savory proteins.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_yum) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_yum)[[2]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/)[[3]](https://lionbrand.com.au/recipes/tom-yum-goong-recipe-thai-hot-and-sour-soup/)[[4]](https://thewoksoflife.com/tom-yum-soup/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfBeuebpFkU&t=12)

Key Flavors and Ingredients

- **The Herbal Trinity:** Lemongrass, galangal (a root like ginger), and makrut lime leaves give the soup its signature scent and taste.
- **Spicy and Sour:** Fresh Thai bird's eye chilies add heat, while fresh lime juice provides a sharp, tangy sourness.
- **Savory Depth:** Fish sauce provides saltiness and umami.
- **Proteins and Veggies:** Commonly made with shrimp (known as *Tom Yum Goong* ), chicken, fish, or tofu, along with straw or oyster mushrooms.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZcGqfJSo5hU&vl=en&t=249)[[2]](https://thewoksoflife.com/tom-yum-soup/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfBeuebpFkU&t=12)[[4]](https://thaisq.com/an-interesting-story-about-tom-yum-goong/)

Main Types of Tom Yum

- **Clear Broth (*Tom Yum Nam Sai*):** A light, translucent, and intensely herbal soup.
- **Creamy Broth (*Tom Yum Nam Khon*):** The same basic herbal base, but made richer with sweet Thai chili paste (*nam prik pao* ) and a splash of evaporated milk or coconut milk.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/tom-yum-soup-thai/) [[1]](https://www.recipetineats.com/tom-yum-soup-thai/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/elZkem3n_qs)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRUliILEdKh/?hl=en)[[4]](https://guide.michelin.com/en/article/features/thai-soups-explained-tom-kha-tom-yum-tom-klong-and-tom-som)
